Lenovo, Acer to launch new Windows PCs with Nvidia RTX Spark chips in October

Lenovo and Acer are set to launch new Windows personal computers in October that will be powered by Nvidia's RTX Spark chips. These new PCs are expected to offer enhanced graphics and AI capabilities. The announcement indicates a collaboration between PC manufacturers and chip technology providers to bring advanced features to the consumer market.
